import math
import sys

def main():
    epsilon = 1e-15
    x, y, N = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    target = x / y
    bestNum = x
    bestDen = y
    minDiff = float('inf')

    for d in range(1, N + 1):
        numer = x * d / y
        floorVal = math.floor(numer)
        ceilVal = math.ceil(numer)
        
        approxFloor = floorVal / d
        approxCeil = ceilVal / d
        
        diffFloor = abs(approxFloor - target)
        diffCeil = abs(approxCeil - target)
        
        if diffCeil < diffFloor - epsilon:
            if diffCeil < minDiff - epsilon:
                minDiff = diffCeil
                bestNum = ceilVal
                bestDen = d
        elif diffFloor < diffCeil - epsilon:
            if diffFloor < minDiff - epsilon:
                minDiff = diffFloor
                bestNum = floorVal
                bestDen = d
        else:
            if diffFloor < minDiff - epsilon:
                minDiff = diffFloor
                bestNum = floorVal
                bestDen = d
    
    print(f"{bestNum}/{bestDen}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
